items.text: haan ji
kal tak
theek hai

items.context: Kya aapka recharge successful hua tha?
items.text: abhi nahi

items.context: Kya aapne last week recharge kara tha?
items.text: woh thik hai

items.context: Kya aap dobara recharge try karna chahte hain?
items.text: thoda ruk jao
mera paisa to cut gaya lekin balance nahi aaya
kal raat ko recharge kara tha par plan activate nahi hua
mainne do din pehle recharge kara tha par message nahi aaya
maine 99 rupees ka plan liya tha par kuch bhi nahi mila
mera recharge fail to nahi hua tha par balance update nahi ho raha
woh matlab mujhe plan chahiye tha par balance zero he dikha
mera phone recharge hua tha par plan activate hone mein der ho gayi

items.context: Kya aap mujhe recharge ki date batayenge?
items.text: haan ji maine aaj subah recharge kiya tha par balance nahi hai

items.context: Aapne kaunsa payment mode use kiya recharge ke liye?
items.text: matlab mujhe lagta hai ki transaction to successful tha par credit nahi hua

items.context: Recharge kab kiya gaya tha aapne?
items.text: nahi sir weekend par recharge tha jo abhi tak reflect nahi hua

items.context: Kya aapne apne account se transaction history check ki hai?
items.text: woh mujhe lagta hai galti se double recharge ho gaya aur dono baar paise cut gaye

items.context: Kya aapke paas confirmation message aaya tha recharge ke liye?
items.text: accha recharge toh hua tha lekin plan use karne se pahle hi balance zero ho gaya
mai ne kal hi recharge kara tha par mera balance kabhi bhi update nahi hua hai mujhe paisa kaatne aur recharge dono ka pota hai
meri taraf se sab kuch thik tha recharge amount bhi cut gaya lekin mera plan activate nahi hua mujhe turant madad chahiye
maine link pe click karke recharge kara tha par paise to mere bank account se kat gaye lekin sim mein balance nahi dikh raha hai

items.context: Kya aap mujhe apne recharge ke details de sakte hain?
items.text: haan ji paise to cut gaye hain par mujhe plan activate hone mein problem aa rahi thi kya aap check kar sakte hain

items.context: Aapne kis din recharge kiya tha aur kya aap payment confirmation le sakte hain?
items.text: nahi recharge Tuesday ko kiya tha matlab nahi Wednesday ko maine confuse kar diya anyway paise kat gaye par credited nahi hua

items.context: Kya aap mujhe transaction ID ya reference number provide kar sakte hain?
items.text: matlab main ne poora recharge complete kiya tha aur confirmation bhi mila tha lekin abhi tak mera balance update nahi hua jab maine customer service se baat ki thi to woh bhi kuch nahi bata paye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: recharge_not_credited - recharged but the plan or balance was not credited
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
